portInfo.description: Norwegian Cruise Line presents Great Stirrup Cay as its private Bahamas island destination, highlighting the Great Tides Waterpark (Tidal Tower slides, Wandering River ~250 m, Cliffside Cove, Splash Cay) alongside beach time. Access is for guests on scheduled NCL calls — not a public ferry port. Pier/tender minutes and capacity figures were not listed as engineering data on the marketing page used; keep pins null.
